row.team_price_text: PRO: $250/year for up to 20 resources, unlimited users
row.evidence: Ganttic's SSO guide offers OneLogin, Microsoft Azure AD, Google and any SAML 2.0 provider (SAML on PRO accounts only), and neither the help centre nor the API reference documents SCIM; users are added manually or via the REST API.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Pricing is by resource count with unlimited free users: Free up to 10 resources (no API), PRO from $250/year (20 resources) up to $7,900/year (1,500 resources), custom above that; prices read from the pricing page's slider data, so per-user fields stay null. SAML 2.0 and OneLogin SSO need a PRO account and an account subdomain; Microsoft/Google sign-in need users to exist first. No SCIM or IdP provisioning; the REST API (all PRO plans) can list, create, update and delete users with an account token.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the help centre (search 'scim' and 'provisioning' return 0 articles) or the OpenAPI spec. Users are added by hand, via invite, or via the REST API. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Single account-wide token passed as the 'token' query parameter; Owners and Admins get it under Settings > API. Generating a new token revokes the old one.

capabilities.notes: Create requires email and password. The user object returns a 'type' field (user/admin/owner) but the spec does not say it is writable. No user-group endpoints.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks cover task, resource and project add/update/delete only.

limitations.text: API is not available on the Free plan (10 resources or fewer).

okta.notes: www.okta.com/integrations/ganttic/ returned 404; no Okta guide in the help centre (search 'okta' returned 0 articles).

entra.notes: 'Sign in with Microsoft' must be allowed for Ganttic in the Entra admin center; users must already exist in Ganttic. No Entra Learn tutorial found (ganttic-tutorial 404). Provisioning false by absence.

google.notes: Only consumer 'Sign in with Google' (not a Workspace SAML app); not counted as SSO.

onelogin.notes: From Ganttic's own OneLogin guide (OneLogin catalogue page not loaded). Provisioning false by absence.

fallbacks.notes: Microsoft SSO requires matching existing Ganttic users; Google sign-in with an unknown email creates a new Ganttic account rather than adding the user to the organisation, so it is not recorded as JIT. CSV import covers resources, tasks and projects, not users.

Whether the API can set a user's type (role) or user groups is not documented.
